### The Region and the World
**Chagos Islands deal ‘can’t go ahead’ without US support, Streeting says: The Guardian**

UK Health Secretary Wes Streeting said the agreement under which Britain will surrender the Chagos Islands cannot proceed without United States support. The statement came as the government weighs the diplomatic and strategic implications of the territory transfer. 
Source: https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/sep/23/chagos-islands-diego-garcia-streeting-us-support

### Both Sides: Restarting nuclear power in Italy
Italy’s Senate approved legislation that authorises the government to restart nuclear power generation. The government argues that advanced modular reactors will help decarbonise industry and strengthen energy security while shielding the economy from price surges caused by conflicts in the Middle East.
